traits.name: Efficient Capture
traits.text: ⬽ (attack, manipulate); Requirements The jailer has manacles in hand and is adjacent to a creature Effect The jailer attempts to bind the creature's wrists or ankles with the manacles. If the jailer succeeds at an attack roll with a +9 modifier against the target's AC, they apply the manacles.

traits.name: Intimidating Strike
traits.text: ⬺ (emotion, fear, fighter, mental); The jailer makes a melee Strike. If it hits and deals damage, the target is frightened 1, or frightened 2 on a critical hit.

traits.name: Subdue Prisoners
traits.text: The jailer doesn't take the normal penalty for making a nonlethal attack when attacking with their club.

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ crossbow +10 (range increment 120 feet, reload 1); Damage 1d8+4 (1d8+4) piercing
